create.name: Brenda Rose
create.bio:
Brenda Rose is a psychic medium and intuitive teacher who lives in Cincinnati, Ohio, and has been reading for clients for around thirty years. She came to this work alongside a career in business consulting and public speaking, and she still brings a practical, plain-spoken streak to it. A typical reading with her weaves mediumship together with tarot, astrology and numerology, and she often describes life as 'Earth School', a place where hard lessons are part of the curriculum and help from the other side is close at hand.

Tarot is her first love. She imagined her own deck, the Beauty of Tarot, which the artist Carol Denison designed, and she teaches it in a beginners' level, an advanced in-person course and a club for past students. Other classes cover meeting your spirit guides, building trust in intuition, the Enneagram, and a women's circle built around ritual and sacred boundaries. She records short guided meditations for each new and full moon on her YouTube channel, sells longer meditation sets on her site, and for five years co-hosted a podcast on the unseen world with the writer Julie Rieger. Each year she leads residential retreats at Omega Institute in New York and at Esalen in Big Sur.

courses.title: Finding Your Spirit Guides (Omega Institute)
courses.description: A five-night residential retreat on Omega's Rhinebeck campus about forming a steady relationship with one's guides. Days mix teaching, meditation, quiet reflection and small-group sharing, and no previous meditation experience is needed.

courses.title: Finding Your Spirit Guides (Esalen)
courses.description: The same spirit-guides programme held over four nights at Esalen on the Big Sur coast of California. Esalen quotes all-inclusive rates that cover lodging and meals.

courses.title: Private Reading (60 minutes)
courses.description: An hour-long personal session led by mediumship and supported by tarot, astrology and numerology, aimed at questions of direction and purpose. New clients join a waiting list for the next opening.

courses.title: The Beauty of Tarot – Level 1
courses.description: Her foundation class in reading the cards, taught with her own Beauty of Tarot deck. It covers the meaning of each card and how to give a clear reading; a waiting list opens when dates are set.

courses.title: Connecting With Your Spirit Guides (online)
courses.description: A small online class that uses guided meditation to introduce participants to the guides she believes travel with each of us. Numbers are limited and sign-up is by waiting list.

courses.title: Ignite Your Intuition
courses.description: A self-paced recording of a five-module telecourse from 2019, with handouts. It looks at telling true inner guidance apart from fear or habit and learning to act on it.

courses.title: Activate Your Energy: A Meditation Practice
courses.description: A four-part video series of meditations and visualisations for clearing and refilling one's energy field. Access starts straight away and it can be used at any pace.

courses.title: Connections Meditations
courses.description: Seven downloadable guided meditations, between 13 and 28 minutes each and about two hours in total, focused on relaxation, joy and a sense of the divine. Suitable for beginners.

courses.title: Enneagram 101: How to Live Your Life With Greater Compassion, Power, and Peace
courses.description: A five-week introduction to the nine Enneagram types and the habits each one tends to repeat. Offered by waiting list when a new round opens.

courses.title: Athena's Magical Secrets
courses.description: A women's leadership circle that uses ritual, boundaries and daily spiritual practice as a base for personal and professional goals. Places open by waiting list.
